name: Pristine Aqua
look: a primeval slate-blue Kyogre with a white mouth, red eyes, a red flank line, red ringed markings on its great fins and rows of heavy black claws
entry: A Pokémon resembling Kyogre, described in a sailor's tale of a clawed beast that churned the primeval seas. Its claws can rake the seabed into new trenches.
how: Wild: very rare in deep oceans while it rains.
